title: BulkReassignItemsRequest v1
description: POST /items/bulk-reassign request body (D-206/D-207, Roadmap P1 item 17). Each entry carries its own expectedVersion - preserves the same per-item OCC guarantee a single-item PUT /items/{itemId} already gets via If-Match, since a bulk request has no single version to attach to a header. assigneeUserId empty string clears the assignee (same convention as UpdateItemRequest).
